package config

import (
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// 与 C++ 侧 configgen_cpp_test.cpp 同一份 schema、同一组期望：两种语言的行为要一致。

func TestDefaults(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewGateConfig()
	if c.Name != "gate" || c.HeartbeatSec != 30 || c.Ratio != 0.5 || c.Neg != -5 || c.SmallF != 1.5 || !c.On {
		t.Fatalf("标量默认值不对: %+v", c)
	}
	if c.Big != 18446744073709551615 {
		t.Fatalf("uint64 默认值不对: %d", c.Big)
	}
	if c.Mode != ModeFast || c.Level != LevelInfo {
		t.Fatalf("枚举默认值不对: %v %v", c.Mode, c.Level)
	}
	if c.Creds.User != "u" || c.Tuning.A != 1 || c.Tuning.B != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("嵌套结构体的默认值没有填: %+v %+v", c.Creds, c.Tuning)
	}
	if c.Modes != nil || c.Endpoints != nil || c.Opt != nil || c.OptEp != nil {
		t.Fatalf("容器 / optional 默认应该是空")
	}
}

func TestValidate(t *testing.T) {
	good := NewGateConfig()
	good.TcpPort = 80
	good.Seeds = []string{"a"} // min_count: 1
	if err := good.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("合法配置被拒绝: %v", err)
	}

	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*GateConfig)
		want   string
	}{
		{"范围", func(c *GateConfig) { c.TcpPort = 70000 }, "tcp_port"},
		{"负数范围", func(c *GateConfig) { c.Neg = 11 }, "neg"},
		{"浮点范围", func(c *GateConfig) { c.Ratio = 1.5 }, "ratio"},
		{"枚举", func(c *GateConfig) { c.Mode = "turbo" }, "mode"},
		{"import 的枚举", func(c *GateConfig) { c.Level = "trace" }, "level"},
		{"list 元素的枚举", func(c *GateConfig) { c.Modes = []Mode{ModeFast, "bad"} }, "modes[1]"},
		{"list 里的结构体", func(c *GateConfig) { c.Endpoints = []Endpoint{{Host: "a", Port: 0}} }, "endpoints[0]"},
		{"optional 结构体", func(c *GateConfig) { c.OptEp = &Endpoint{Host: "a", Port: 99999} }, "opt_ep"},
		{"map 里的结构体", func(c *GateConfig) { c.ByName = map[string]Endpoint{"m": {Host: "a", Port: 0}} }, "by_name.m"},
		{"min_count", func(c *GateConfig) { c.Seeds = []string{} }, "seeds"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		c := good
		tc.mutate(&c)
		err := c.Validate()
		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.want) {
			t.Errorf("%s: 期望错误里含 %q，实际 %v", tc.name, tc.want, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestRequiredKeys(t *testing.T) {
	if got := (GateConfig{}).RequiredKeys(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{"tcp_port"}) {
		t.Errorf("GateConfig 必填键: %v", got)
	}
	if got := (Endpoint{}).RequiredKeys(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{"host", "port"}) {
		t.Errorf("Endpoint 必填键: %v", got)
	}
	if got := (Tuning{}).RequiredKeys(); got != nil {
		t.Errorf("Tuning 没有必填键: %v", got)
	}
}

func TestRedacted(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewGateConfig()
	c.Creds.Password = "hunter2"
	c.Creds.Pin = 4321
	c.Endpoints = []Endpoint{{Host: "a", Port: 80}}
	r := c.Redacted()
	if r.Creds.Password != "***" || r.Creds.Pin != 0 || r.Creds.User != "u" {
		t.Fatalf("打码结果不对: %+v", r.Creds)
	}
	if c.Creds.Password != "hunter2" || c.Creds.Pin != 4321 {
		t.Fatalf("原对象被改了: %+v", c.Creds)
	}
	r.Endpoints[0].Host = "changed" // 副本里的切片不能和原对象共享底层数组
	if c.Endpoints[0].Host != "a" {
		t.Fatalf("Redacted 的切片与原对象共享了内存")
	}
}

func TestNonReloadableChanges(t *testing.T) {
	cur := NewGateConfig()
	cur.Endpoints = []Endpoint{{Host: "a", Port: 80}}

	next := cur
	next.HeartbeatSec = 99 // reloadable
	next.Ratio = 0.9       // reloadable
	next.Tuning.A = 100    // tuning 整个子树 reloadable
	if got := cur.NonReloadableChanges(next); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("只改了可热更的字段，却报了 %v", got)
	}

	next.TcpPort = 8001
	next.Name = "other"
	next.Creds.Password = "new" // secret 一定不可热更
	next.Endpoints = append([]Endpoint{}, cur.Endpoints...)
	next.Endpoints = append(next.Endpoints, Endpoint{Host: "b", Port: 81})
	want := []string{"name", "tcp_port", "creds.password", "endpoints"}
	if got := cur.NonReloadableChanges(next); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("期望 %v，实际 %v", want, got)
	}
}
